scenario: 今天生成式这条线的主题是把生成式推荐真正跑在线上，并且跑得便宜。ReuseGR 让大模型按搜索词离线生成编码前缀，在线只留小模型做个性化补全；ZeroGR 把约束解码改成先过滤再打分，省掉大量白算的候选。OneTrans-GSR 往下游走了一步，用一个模型直接生成整屏的重排和混排结果，SPADE 则把本地生活的搜索词推荐做成一个兼顾位置和多样性的生成模型。另一组论文看大模型推荐 agent 的弱点：τ-Rec-Books 测出 agent 不会主动问需求，另一篇发现一条编造的安全隐患评论就能让 agent 改选攻击者的目标。

papers.title: ReuseGR: Offline--Online Decoupled Generative Retrieval via Adaptive Prefix Reuse
papers.authors: Xujing Wang, Yufeng Chen, Boxuan Zhang, Chao Wei, Cai Xu, Jie Zhao, Weiru Zhang, Wei Zhao, Ziyu Guan
papers.abstract: Larger generative retrieval models can improve retrieval quality, but their decoding cost makes low-latency serving difficult. When different users submit the same query, generating complete Semantic IDs (SIDs) for every request repeats computation, while their interaction histories call for different results. The challenge is to reuse large-model computation across requests while keeping retrieval personalized. We propose \textbf{ReuseGR}, which separates query-level candidate planning from request-level personalized completion. A 7B offline planner generates SID prefix sets shared across requests with the same query. A 0.5B online model uses each request's history to select prefixes and generate the remaining tokens. ReuseCut chooses a cache depth for each query based on historical coverage, balancing computation reuse and candidate coverage. To strengthen online completion, we transfer 7B suffix-scoring knowledge to 0.5B through path-level knowledge distillation (Path KD). BudgetCut then selects scored branches to improve final top-100 recall under a fixed branch budget. Its selection policy is initialized by on-policy distillation (OPD) and refined through group-relative policy optimization (GRPO). On an industrial search-advertising dataset with approximately 2M query--item records and 3.38M catalog items, ReuseGR improves query-level HR@100 by 3.83 percentage points and reduces mean online latency by 38.9\% relative to an all-online 0.5B baseline when prefixes are prepared. It achieves HR@100 comparable to an all-online 7B baseline with 57.7\% lower online latency. A 14-day user-level online A/B test against the 0.5B baseline shows relative gains of 0.93\% in click-through rate and 1.05\% in revenue per thousand requests.
papers.note: SID prefix reuse; online A/B and latency evidence
papers.summary: 做生成式检索上线的团队值得读：它给出了一种拆法，大模型的算力按搜索词复用，个性化留给在线小模型，并且有线上 A/B 验证。同一个搜索词每天被很多人搜，每次都从头生成完整的 Semantic ID 是在重复计算。ReuseGR 把活拆成两半：离线用大模型给每个搜索词先生成一批 SID 前缀，同词的请求共用；在线用小模型按当前用户的历史挑前缀，再补全剩下的 token。在一个搜索广告数据集上，假设前缀已提前缓存好，它的召回和全程在线跑大模型持平，在线延迟却低 57.7%；线上 A/B 里，点击率比原来的小模型方案相对提高 0.93%。

deep_reading.title: ReuseGR: Offline--Online Decoupled Generative Retrieval via Adaptive Prefix Reuse

papers.title: ZeroGR: Filtering-First Constrained Decoding for Generative Recommendation
papers.authors: Xiangrui Yang, Jiawei Yang, Liang Zeng, Daqian Ding, Ziqian Liu, Bing Tian, Cheng Peng, Yunfeng Zhao, Fangyu Zhang, Jiaqiang Liu, Xiao Liang, Yiming Qiu
papers.abstract: Generative recommendation is gaining traction in production, retrieving items by generating their identifiers one token at a time. The generated sequences must identify relevant catalog items, so constrained decoding couples relevance scoring with validity filtering. Because most possible sequences are invalid, scoring before filtering wastes computation on candidates that will be discarded. Our evaluation shows that filtering first can avoid this work with negligible impact on recommendation quality. We present ZeroGR, a filtering-first constrained decoding system for generative recommendation. ZeroGR uses a step-sliced filtering index to reduce GPU memory use by tailoring data representations to each decoding step. Its execution engine adopts shared-slot execution to accelerate data exchange across stages and hybrid projection to adapt computation to workload patterns, thereby reducing execution overhead. During index refreshes, ZeroGR applies layout-guided streaming construction to speed up updates and limit serving interference. Extensive evaluation shows that ZeroGR accelerates the filtering and scoring pipeline by up to $9.9\times$ over representative baselines while reducing GPU index memory use and accelerating index reconstruction.
papers.note: Constrained decoding; quantified speedup; no online A/B in abstract
papers.summary: 做生成式推荐服务的工程团队值得读：它指出约束解码的大部分计算花在注定被丢弃的候选上，并给出先过滤的系统实现。生成式推荐逐个 token 生成物品编码，每步都要保证编码对应目录里真有的物品。常见做法是先给所有可能的下一个 token 打分，再把无效的过滤掉，这些分数大多白算。作者先验证：先过滤再打分，返回的物品和原来重合约 99.9%。ZeroGR 为此做了两件事。一是按解码步切开过滤索引，候选少的步用稀疏格式存，候选多的步用稠密格式存，省下显存。二是同一步里每个 beam 分到一样多的候选槽位，过滤和打分直接读写槽位，不用先压紧候选列表，少算的分数才变成真实提速。过滤、打分加挑选候选这一段比代表性基线最多快 9.9 倍。

papers.title: OneTrans-GSR: A Generative Slate Ranking Paradigm Unifying Reranking and Mix-Ranking with One Autoregressive Transformer
papers.authors: Feng Cheng, Yu-Hsuan Huang, Fengyi Wang, Chaofan Zhou, Zhennan Zhu, Huan He, Bo Zhang, Ruoqi Zhang, Zhanfeng Mo, Ziwei Liu, Lanyi Li, Yifeng Pan, Junhua Long, Ziqiu Zhou, Yue Lin, Shaowei Liu
papers.abstract: Industrial recommender systems allocate substantial computation to pointwise candidate scoring, yet separate reranking and mix-ranking stages still assemble the final exposure slate using hand-crafted rules and specialized low-capacity models. Mix-ranking combines product cards, short videos, livestreams, and advertising cards supplied by distinct upstream business channels. Although these rules and models encode valuable domain knowledge, they are inherently limited in leveraging additional data and computation. They constrain the combinatorial space of candidate slates and determine objective trade-offs through manual tuning. To enable scalable and effective slate generation, we reformulate reranking and mix-ranking as a unified learning problem whose performance can improve with computation. Specifically, we instantiate this formulation across the reranking and mix-ranking stages and propose OneTrans-GSR, a single decoder-only policy that extends our deployed OneTrans backbone to generate the exposure slate end-to-end. During training, a reward model evaluates complete slates and guides reinforcement learning toward slate-level and long-term objectives. During decoding, business constraints are explicitly enforced. Offline evaluation shows that slate quality consistently improves as reward-model and policy compute increase. Deployed in a large-scale industrial recommendation system, OneTrans-GSR mixes heterogeneous content types within a unified slate. In online A/B tests, it improves GMV/u by 2.63%, advertiser value by 2.06%, and repurchase rate by 2.03%, while reducing end-to-end latency across the reranking and mix-ranking stages by 13%. These results mark a paradigm shift in slate generation: moving beyond human-engineered heuristics toward a general learned policy creates a scalable path for further algorithmic optimization and compute-driven improvement.
papers.note: Autoregressive slate generation; production A/B and latency
papers.summary: 做重排和混排的团队值得读：它把这两个长期靠规则的环节变成一个能靠加算力变好的生成问题，并且已经全量上线。决定这一屏展示什么的重排和混排，一直靠手写规则和小模型：商品卡、短视频、直播、广告卡怎么穿插，权重靠人调。OneTrans-GSR 把这两步合成一个自回归 Transformer，一个位置一个位置地生成整屏结果。训练时由一个奖励模型给整屏打分，引导强化学习。业务规则在解码时处理。必须满足的规则直接屏蔽违规候选，间隔和配额这类规则给违规候选扣分。离线实验里，奖励模型越大，它判断整屏好坏越准。上线后，人均 GMV 提高 2.63%，重排加混排的端到端延迟还降了 13%。

papers.title: HARP: Training-Free Dual-Profile Agentic Communication for LLM-Based Recommendation
papers.authors: Zhen Tao, Xun Zhou, Xuhui Chen, Ziyue Qiao, Qingqiang Sun
papers.abstract: In LLM-based recommendation, memory acts as a user-level agent in a memory-augmented backbone. Yet users and items remain asymmetric: only the user is given a structured profile; it enters a bandwidth-limited reranker prompt; and it is frozen after warmup. We recast LLM-based recommendation as an agentic-communication process in four stages: BUILD a self-description, TRANSMIT it along the collaborative graph, UNDERSTAND the other side, and SYNC it from the next interaction. This formulation reveals three unresolved communication challenges: the item side never produces a comparable self-description (one-sided BUILD); profile-level signals enter only the bandwidth-limited reranker prompt rather than retrieval, where they would not compete for context tokens (prompt-trapped UNDERSTAND); and the user's description is frozen after warmup with no principled update rule (absent SYNC). We instantiate the missing stages as HARP (Homophily-aware Agentic Recommendation via dual Profiles), a training-free, three-operator addition to a frozen LLM backbone: a rule-extracted symmetric item profile (zero extra LLM calls), a channel-decomposable profile-level homophily H(phi_u, phi_i) consumed at retrieval time rather than inside the reranker prompt, and a single-pass reflective update realising in-context profile evolution without any gradient step. On four public benchmarks (Yelp, Books, MovieTV, Goodreads), HARP lifts Hit@1 over the strongest published baseline by 6.9%-24.0%, with family-wise Holm-corrected p < 1e-9 on every dataset. Ablations and a per-case attribution study show that the operators contribute complementary gains, with the retrieval-side gate as the main source; we also report the trade-off introduced by the reflective pass. We formulate agentic communication and provide a training-free instantiation. Code is available at https://github.com/Jove-Zhen/HARP.
papers.note: Training-free LLM recommendation; four benchmarks and released code
papers.summary: 用大模型做推荐时，常给用户写一段画像，物品却没有对等的描述；用户画像只塞进重排提示词，和别的内容抢长度。HARP（本文提出的方法）不训练参数。它让物品也有一份画像，同样分偏好、品质、场景、受众四栏，用规则从元数据和评论里填。重排前，原有方法会按行为相似度挑一批用户和物品当协同邻居，把它们的文字记录送进重排提示词。HARP 按画像相近程度给这些邻居的分数打折，画像越不像，打折越多，越难入选。四个公开数据集上，Hit@1 比最强的已发表基线高 6.9% 到 24.0%，消融显示给邻居加权贡献最大。

papers.title: τ-Rec-Books: A Disclosure-Controlled Benchmark for Requirement Elicitation in Agentic Recommender Systems
papers.authors: Bharath Sivaram Narasimhan, Karthik R. Narasimhan
papers.abstract: While conversational recommendation systems provide a more natural user interface, they face the challenge of progressively discovering a user's needs before they can recommend an item that satisfies them. To evaluate the ability of AI agents at this elicitation process, we introduce τ-Rec-Books, a benchmark that holds each user request fixed while varying only when the user reveals their requirements: all at the start (volunteer), one at the start and the rest when asked (mixed), or some never (hidden). A hidden requirement can be found only by proposing books and inferring it from the user's accept or reject verdicts. We generate 450 tasks over a catalog of 20,000 books from Wikidata, develop a rule-based simulated user to answer the agent, and score recommendations against catalog metadata without an LLM judge. Across four agents and two search interfaces, success rates fall for every agent and interface, on average from 0.975 (volunteer) to 0.756 (mixed) and 0.283 (hidden). Mixed tasks fail mainly because agents do not ask, and when told to ask, every agent reaches at least 0.931. On hidden tasks, most failures come from agents recommending a book they never proposed to the user. When told to propose first, agents only match a simple baseline that proposes popular books, and stay well below one that uses rejection to rule out possible requirements. We release the catalog pipeline, task generator, simulated user, validators, reference agents, and all agent traces at https://github.com/nbharaths/tau-rec/tree/main/data/tracks/books-wikidata-v2.
papers.note: Conversational recommendation evaluation; released tasks and traces
papers.summary: 对话式推荐难在用户不会一开口就把要求说全。τ-Rec-Books 固定同一个找书请求，只改变用户什么时候说出要求：一开始全说，开头说一条、其余等问了再说，或者有些要求始终不说。不说的要求只能靠先提几本书、看用户接受还是拒绝来推断。在有解的任务上，四个 agent 的平均成功率从全说时的 0.975 掉到要问才说时的 0.756，有隐藏要求时只剩 0.283。要问才说的任务失败，主要因为 agent 根本不问。在提示词里明确要求它提问，成功率就回到 0.93 以上。隐藏要求的任务里，agent 常把从没给用户看过的书直接当成答案。评估推荐 agent，要看它会不会主动问，会不会用拒绝来排除可能的要求。

deep_reading.title: τ-Rec-Books: A Disclosure-Controlled Benchmark for Requirement Elicitation in Agentic Recommender Systems

papers.title: SPADE: Spatiotemporal Preference Alignment and Diversity Enhancement for Local Search
papers.authors: Chenxu Wang, Wenxuan Yang, Yueqi Mou, Shuxian Bi, Biao Tang, Peng Yan
papers.abstract: Proactive query recommendation aims to suggest relevant search queries to users on the homepage of local service apps. Unlike conventional recommendation over a fixed item set, this requires open-set generation from a vocabulary of millions, where outputs must simultaneously align with user preference, match fine-grained spatiotemporal context, cover long-tail intents, and provide diverse alternatives within a few candidate slots. Existing approaches address these axes in isolation: standard tokenization suppresses long-tail queries, coarse location encoding misses fine-grained geographic demand, generic preference optimization fails to align with production impression-click distributions, and standard beam search collapses to near-duplicate outputs. We present SPADE (Spatiotemporal Preference Alignment and Diversity Enhancement), an end-to-end generative framework that jointly optimizes the generation space, contextual representation, preference distribution, and output slate quality through four components: Objective-Aligned BPE (OA-BPE) aligns subword merging with business value signals to boost long-tail query generation probability; Spatio-Temporal Adaptive Representation (STAR) replaces coarse location tokens with continuous multi-scale encodings and soft gating for precise spatiotemporal grounding; MARS-DPO (Multi-dimensional Adaptive Reward Sampling DPO) combines cross-domain pre-training with preference alignment on production impression-click data via composite rewards and adaptive hard negative sampling; and Sigmoid Diversity Beam Search (SDBS) improves intent coverage without sacrificing recall. Offline experiments on large-scale production data show that SPADE outperforms the strongest generative baseline by +5.6% HR@5, -40.3% GeoC@5, and +1.9% Exec@5. A one-week online A/B test confirms production impact: +1.88% Module CTR, +0.177% Search Volume, and +0.105% Search DAU.
papers.note: Generative query suggestion; production A/B; query generation overlaps AI search
papers.summary: 本地生活 App 首页要从几百万个可能的搜索词里生成几条给用户，几条之间不能重复，还要对得上用户此刻的位置。输入时，用户的精确坐标和当前小时被编码成向量加进去。离线 HR@5 比最强的生成式基线相对高 5.6%，推荐的店离用户的平均距离缩短 40.3%；一周线上 A/B 里，模块点击率提高 1.88%。

deep_reading.title: SPADE: Spatiotemporal Preference Alignment and Diversity Enhancement for Local Search

papers.title: SourceFlow: Collaborative Source Coupling for Flow-Based Recommendation
papers.authors: Chenghao Wu, Yongqi Zhou, Jin Chen, Yifeng Zhou, Jinchang Zhu, Junwei Pan, Chao Zhou, Zhixiang Feng, Chengguo Yin, Menglin Yang
papers.abstract: Diffusion-based recommenders learn user preferences by denoising interaction histories, but the added noise can distort the original preference signals. Flow-based collaborative filtering (CF) instead learns a discrete path from a sampled source to the user's observed training interactions (the target history), enabling inference in a few steps. Existing flow-based CF methods sample sources using global item frequencies to reflect the sparsity and popularity of observed interactions. Each source is sampled independently of its target history, leaving the predictor without user-specific source cues for learning to reconstruct that history. We propose SourceFlow, which brings collaborative structure into the source distribution itself rather than adding further conditioning to the predictor. Like inference from observed histories, training uses collaborative evidence to predict missing interactions. Specifically, Neighborhood Coupling constructs displaced binary sources by replacing historical items with unobserved collaborative alternatives. Collaborative Consensus further refines replacement probabilities using evidence from other interactions of users who share the observed item. Stretched Restoration retains these replacements at late flow times during training, providing more opportunities to recover the original interactions. Experiments on five recommendation datasets show consistent improvements over competitive baselines, including a mean relative Recall@10 gain of 15.7% over the strongest flow-based baseline. Controlled experiments confirm that these gains depend on correctly pairing collaborative sources with their target histories, as reassigning the same source vectors across users reverses the gains. Code will be publicly released upon acceptance.
papers.note: Flow CF; five datasets; code not yet released
papers.summary: 基于 Flow 的协同过滤有个容易被忽视的短板：训练的起点和用户毫无关系。这类模型从一个随机起点出发，学着一步步走到用户真实的交互记录；现有方法按全局物品热度独立采样这个起点，模型拿不到个人线索。SourceFlow 改的是起点本身：把用户历史里的部分物品，换成常和它被同一批用户交互、但这个用户没碰过的物品，让训练像推理一样，从带协同信号的记录去补缺失的交互。五个数据集上，Recall@10 比最强的 Flow 方法平均相对高 15.7%。把同样的起点打乱分给别的用户，收益反而消失，说明起作用的是起点和用户的配对。

papers.title: IDs That Mean Something: A Hands-On Tutorial on Semantic IDs for Recommender Systems
papers.authors: Roger Zhe Li, Aghiles Salah, Mete Sertkan, Changhong Jin, Yingjie Niu, Ruihai Dong, Barry Smyth
papers.abstract: Traditional recommender systems rely on arbitrary integer IDs to identify items, which carry no semantic information and force models to learn representations from interaction data. While leveraging content information can partially mitigate cold-start, this paradigm inherently suffers from exploding embedding tables and scenario-specific architectures. Recent years have seen the emergence of semantic IDs, which encode semantic information directly into the item identity, reflecting content, hierarchy, and relationships. This framework addresses the above limitations by offering a principled way to encode large-scale semantic information into item identity, benefiting both generative and discriminative applications and unlocking more native unification across modalities, domains, and tasks. This tutorial traces the evolution from raw IDs to semantic IDs as a scalable means of information utilization, offering a comprehensive review of their development and applications across multi-modality, cold-start, and cross-domain recommendation. Hands-on exercises guide attendees through building and evaluating semantic IDs, training models, and exploring cross-domain transfer. We conclude by discussing open challenges, including dynamic semantic IDs and multi-stakeholder utility. All materials of the tutorial could be found at the official website https://semantic-id-tutorial.github.io.
papers.note: Semantic-ID tutorial; executable materials; no new measured result
papers.summary: 传统推荐给每个物品一个随机整数 ID，ID 本身不带任何含义，模型只能从交互里学 embedding，冷启动物品很吃亏，embedding 表也越做越大。这份动手教程梳理了从普通 ID 到 Semantic ID 的演进，以及它在多模态、冷启动和跨域推荐里的用法，还配了一套练习：构建和评估 SID，训练模型，再做跨域迁移。教程最后讨论了还没解决的问题，比如 SID 怎么随内容变化更新。想系统上手 SID 的工程师，可以直接拿这套练习当入门材料。

papers.title: IntentGEO: Intent-aware Generative Engine Optimization for Recommendation
papers.authors: Runlin Lei, Shiqi Zhang, Xiaokui Xiao, Zhewei Wei
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly shape recommendations across chatbots, e-commerce, and user-generated content (UGC) platforms, creating demand for Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) to improve item visibility in generated responses. Existing GEO studies are mainly content-centric, optimizing visibility under general-purpose queries. However, a shared item description usually serves users with different needs and decision goals, resulting in its visibility gains being dependent on the request. To investigate how changing intent affects visibility, we formulate IntentGEO to evaluate shared rewrites across need specificity and decision progression. We revisit existing GEO methods and find that their visibility gains vary across user intents. More critically, learning-based prompt optimization can underperform its handwritten seed on average. Tracing these updates reveals prompt drift from explicit recommendation instructions toward generic promotional tactics. To address this drift, we propose AMO (Anchored Meta-Optimization), which preserves recommendation instructions in a fixed core while learning appended strategies from citation feedback. Across four domains and ten intent states, AMO improves average citation-rank gain by 35% over the strongest prior learning-based baseline and leads on nine states. Ablations show that learned additions improve on the fixed core alone and that AMO outperforms full-prompt optimization initialized from that core. It also achieves the highest gains in an agentic recommendation pipeline and, after separate adaptation, on Doubao, a commercially deployed, closed-source online assistant. These findings highlight user intent as a key dimension of GEO evaluation and support anchored adaptation across recommendation needs and decision stages.
papers.note: UGC GEO visibility; adjacent optimization objective
papers.summary: 商家改写商品描述，希望大模型在回答里更常推荐自己，这类做法叫生成式引擎优化。可同一段描述要面对需求不同的用户：有人需求还很模糊，有人已经到了做决定的阶段。作者在四个领域、十种用户意图下重测了现有方法，发现提升幅度随意图变化很大；用模型自动优化出来的提示词，平均下来甚至不如它最初那版手写提示词。追查发现，优化过程中提示词慢慢丢掉了明确的推荐指令，变成泛泛的营销话术。作者的 AMO 把推荐指令固定成不动的核心，只学习追加在后面的策略，目标商品在大模型回答里被提到的名次，平均前移幅度比最强的学习型方法高 35%。评估这类优化，要按用户意图分开看。

papers.title: Voluntary Servitude: Weaponized Safety Warning Mechanisms for Controlling AI Agents
papers.authors: Ilan Zendel, Matan Levy, Stav Cohen, Avi Mendelson, Amit LeVi
papers.abstract: LLM agents increasingly act on information retrieved from public sources they treat as credible, which turns a manipulated recommendation into a transaction, a dependency, or a decision with physical consequences. The security literature models this threat as instruction injection, in which an adversary writes a command into retrieved content and deployed defenses learn to recognize command syntax. We show that an attacker can instead steer an agent through the agent's own harm-avoidance. A single fabricated hazard, written as an ordinary review, leads the agent to disqualify the legitimate options and select the attacker's target by its own reasoning, with no command for a detector to recognize. We call this voluntary servitude. These payloads steer agents about as often as instruction injection (60.4% vs. 66.0%), and deployed injection detectors score them as benign, so behind a filter they are 1.7-4.4x more effective. We measure this at the generation stage across six models and ten consumer-service domains, for three attack families, and show that it transfers to production browser agents, outperforming instruction injection, and to a retrieval pipeline (1.0-57.0% end-to-end success, depending on the retriever). We then show that a corroboration requirement added to the agent's instructions removes roughly 95% of the exposure against a non-adaptive attacker without retraining. With the requirement in place, the agent still reads the planted hazard and no longer acts on it.
papers.summary: 操纵 AI agent 不一定要往网页里写指令。作者发现，只要在评论区发一条看起来普通的评论，编造一个安全隐患，agent 就会因为训练出的避险倾向排除正规选项，转而选攻击者想推的那个。这种攻击里没有任何命令句，现有的注入检测器会把它判为正常内容。不设过滤时，它让 agent 改选的成功率和指令注入差不多；加上检测器后，它比指令注入有效得多。生产环境里的浏览器 agent 也会中招。在 agent 的指令里加一条要求，危险信息必须有其他来源佐证才采信，攻击成功率就从 68.4% 降到 3.6%。
